mapper.sql: u.user_id AS "userId",u.lgn_id AS "loginId",u.user_nm AS name,u.email_addr AS email,u.tel_no AS phone, u.bsn_part_id AS "partId",u.dev_id AS "developerId",u.user_stts_cd AS status,u.last_lgn_at AS "lastLoginAt",u.rsgn_dt AS "resignationDate"

where.if: AND (u.bsn_part_id=#{partId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_part p WHERE p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.bsn_part_id=#{partId}))
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role r WHERE r.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id=#{roleId})

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.user_info u ORDER BY u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.user_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.user_info user_nm=#{name},email_addr=#{email}, tel_no=#{phone},bsn_part_id=#{partId}, user_stts_cd=#{status},rsgn_dt=#{resignationDate}, updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM sys.user_role WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY role_id
SELECT bsn_part_id FROM sys.user_part WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY bsn_part_id
SELECT prj_id FROM sys.user_prj WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY prj_id

choose.when: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.role WHERE role_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
choose.otherwise: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')

mapper.sql: role_id AS "roleId",role_nm AS name,role_desc AS description,use_yn AS "useYn",data_scope_cd AS "dataScope", admin_yn='Y' AS admin,bltin_yn='Y' AS builtin,snstv_inq_yn='Y' AS "sensitiveInquiry",part_std_chg_auth_yn='Y' AS "partStandardChange"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.role ORDER BY sort_seq,role_id

INSERT INTO sys.role(role_nm,role_desc,use_yn,data_scope_cd,admin_yn,bltin_yn,snstv_inq_yn,part_std_chg_auth_yn,copy_role_id,created_by) VALUES(#{name},#{description},#{useYn},#{dataScope},CASE WHEN #{admin} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,'N',CASE WHEN #{sensitiveInquiry} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{partStandardChange} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{copyRoleId},#{actor}) RETURNING role_id

SELECT m.menu_id AS "menuId",m.menu_nm AS name,m.scrn_id AS "screenId",m.upr_menu_id AS "parentId", COALESCE(a.inq_auth_yn,'N') AS inq,COALESCE(a.reg_auth_yn,'N') AS reg,COALESCE(a.mdfcn_auth_yn,'N') AS mdfcn, COALESCE(a.del_auth_yn,'N') AS del,COALESCE(a.upld_auth_yn,'N') AS upld,COALESCE(a.dwnld_auth_yn,'N') AS dwnld,COALESCE(a.cnfrm_auth_yn,'N') AS cnfrm FROM sys.menu m LEFT JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.menu_id=m.menu_id AND a.role_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.sort_seq,m.menu_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.role_menu_auth(role_id,menu_id,inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn,del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn,updated_by) VALUES(#{roleId},#{menuId},#{inq},#{reg},#{mdfcn},#{del},#{upld},#{dwnld},#{cnfrm},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(role_id,menu_id) DO UPDATE SET inq_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.mdfcn_auth_yn, del_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.cnfrm_auth_yn,updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by

INSERT INTO sys.role_menu_auth(role_id,menu_id,inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn,del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn) SELECT #{target},menu_id,inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn,del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn FROM sys.role_menu_auth WHERE role_id=#{source}
mapper.select: SELECT menu_id AS "menuId",upr_menu_id AS "parentId",menu_nm AS name,scrn_id AS "screenId",icon_nm AS icon, sort_seq AS "sortOrder",use_yn AS "useYn",mbl_expsr_yn='Y' AS "mobileVisible" FROM sys.menu ORDER BY sort_seq,menu_id

INSERT INTO sys.menu(upr_menu_id,menu_nm,scrn_id,icon_nm,sort_seq,use_yn,mbl_expsr_yn,created_by) VALUES(#{parentId},#{name},#{screenId},#{icon},#{sortOrder},#{useYn},CASE WHEN #{mobileVisible} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{actor}) RETURNING menu_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.menu SET upr_menu_id=#{parentId},menu_nm=#{name},icon_nm=#{icon},sort_seq=#{sortOrder},use_yn=#{useYn}, mbl_expsr_yn=CASE WHEN #{mobileVisible} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE menu_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM sys.role WHERE admin_yn='Y' ORDER BY role_id FOR UPDATE

WITH RECURSIVE active_menu AS (SELECT menu_id,upr_menu_id,scrn_id FROM sys.menu WHERE upr_menu_id IS NULL AND use_yn='Y' UNION ALL SELECT m.menu_id,m.upr_menu_id,m.scrn_id FROM sys.menu m JOIN active_menu p ON p.menu_id=m.upr_menu_id WHERE m.use_yn='Y') SELECT count(*) FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.user_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND u.rsgn_dt IS NULL AND u.email_addr IS NOT NULL AND trim(u.email_addr) != '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.admin_yn='Y' AND r.use_yn='Y' WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.role_menu_auth a JOIN active_menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id WHERE a.role_id=r.role_id AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' AND a.mdfcn_auth_yn='Y' AND m.scrn_id IN ('UI-23','UI-24','UI-25')))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.login_session SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys.login_session SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE revoked_at IS NULL

UPDATE sys.user_info SET user_stts_cd='ACTIVE',lgn_fail_cnt=0,lock_at=NULL WHERE user_id=#{id} AND user_stts_cd='LOCKED' AND (rsgn_dt IS NULL OR rsgn_dt > (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date)

where.if: AND CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(h.dtl_desc,'jsonb') THEN h.dtl_desc::jsonb->>'result_cd' END=#{result}

mapper.select: SELECT h.acs_hist_id AS "accessHistoryId",h.user_id AS "userId",u.user_nm AS name, h.acs_ty_cd AS type,h.scrn_id AS "screenId",h.obj_desc AS target,h.ip_addr AS "ipAddress",h.created_at AS "createdAt", CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(h.dtl_desc,'jsonb') THEN h.dtl_desc::jsonb->>'result_cd' END AS result FROM sys.acs_hist h LEFT JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=h.user_id ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.acs_hist_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT txt_val='Y' FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id='SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_MAIL_CHANNELS' AND aply_bgn_ym <= to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYY-MM') ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1),false)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.oprt_std(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,txt_val,created_by) VALUES('SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_MAIL_CHANNELS',#{month},'업무 알림 이메일 채널',CASE WHEN #{businessEmailEnabled} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET txt_val=EXCLUDED.txt_val
